description.value:
Traits Paradise-Touched

When one of your spells that deals force damage critically hits with a spell attack roll, the target also takes 1 persistent bleed damage. This applies once per target per spell. The bleed is persistent bleed damage, not force damage, and is stopped in the usual way.

cinderfall.incomplete: On a spell-attack crit with a force-damage spell, add 1 persistent bleed (once per target per spell). The trigger/selector side is real (`"spell-damage"` is a live selector for exactly this kind of class-feature-level `DamageDice` addition, confirmed on `pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/class-features/the-distant-grasp.json`), but every real instance of `DamageDice` found adds genuine dice (`d6`, `d8`...); a bare flat '1' point of persistent damage has no confirmed-valid `DamageDice` shape (a `dieSize: "d1"` workaround is unverified and not seen anywhere in `pf2e-source`).
